policy: Review every closed candidate set. Select only when ASV wording or an explicit mapped textual note distinguishes a reading; otherwise mark underdetermined and retain the base fallback. The base candidate is the qere, which is what MACULA Hebrew projects; the alternative is the ketiv written in the Leningrad Codex.

decisions.evidence: Orthographic qere/ketiv only: qere קְרִיאֵ֣י and ketiv קרואי are the same lexeme (plural construct of the passive adjective 'called ones'), differing solely in the internal mater (א/ו). ASV 'who were called of the congregation' renders either spelling identically, and NUM.26.9 carries no mapped textual note. Nothing in the English distinguishes them, so both remain compatible and the qere base fallback carries the projection.
